# GitHub Copilot Instructions — OpenCode Harness

This project uses a single canonical instructions file for all AI agents:
**`AGENTS.md`** (repository root). GitHub Copilot should read `AGENTS.md` for
all project policies, architecture guidance, and contribution rules.

Any tool-specific `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` in this repo also applies.
`CONVENTIONS.md` contains detailed coding conventions referenced by AGENTS.md.

This file exists to point Copilot at the canonical source rather than
duplicating it.
